fields.name: seniority
fields.description: One of: Intern, Junior, Mid, Senior, Lead

fields.name: salary
fields.description: Salary or rate range as written, or 'Not stated'

fields.name: must_have_skills
fields.description: Comma-separated list of the required skills and tools

fields.name: fit_score
fields.description: How well the candidate fits this job, a whole number from 1 (poor) to 10 (excellent), based only on skills and experience

fields.name: pitch
fields.description: A tailored 3-4 sentence resume summary for this exact job, first person, using the job's own keywords, without inventing experience the candidate does not have

fields.name: cover_opener
fields.description: A strong 2-sentence opening paragraph for a cover letter to this company

fields.name: gaps
fields.description: Required skills the candidate seems to lack, comma-separated, or 'None'
